usedFor: Jotform collects the answers, and Whautomate stores the person as a client when “New Submission” runs “Create Client”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission” in Jotform, then “Create Client” in Whautomate
bestTemplate.why: A form submission turns into a client record, so you do not retype names from the form.

watchOut: When there are no submissions, the “New Submission” sample returns a one-line no-data message instead of a record.
